log.msg: Taken: map the inbox's sources by script, decide the one JSONL set, then build the timeline view in a worktree myself (no minions unless parallel work appears)

findings.text: There is no `decision` line in the task log (req 2). `grep -c '"decision"' task.jsonl` returns 0, yet `doc/inbox-data.md` says the alternatives are in "the `decision` line in the task log". Append the line (Server/decide.mjs), or fix the doc's pointer.

The detail does not have the card's chat in a right sidebar (req 3, the owner's "a right sidebar per card to talk to it"). shots/detail-1920.png shows only an "Open its card, and talk to it" link that leaves the timeline. Embed the card page's existing chat, the way `AISessionDetail` does, or record why it can't be done.

New landings don't reach the timeline on their own. `landings.jsonl` only grows when someone runs `node Landings.mjs --append`, so the `live()` tail has nothing new to show until the `on-landing.mjs` edit lands. The doc gives that edit as exact text, but no `decision` line carries it (see 1).

Every shot logs one 404 (layout.json `errors`, all three pages, both widths), so "smoke clean" (req 4) is unproven. The unrelated `/ext/` page shows the same 404, so it may be older than this change. Name the file.

At 1920, with nothing selected, the timeline leaves the whole screen beside a ~340 px rail empty (shots/…Inbox-timeline/1920.png, empty 0.692). Opening the top row by default at wide widths would put that space to use.

The detail's top line ("landed · … · score 69.9 · landings.jsonl:1301") shows debug data without `?debug`, and about 80 px of space sits between it and the title (shots/detail-1920.png, band 2). Keep the kind and time; move the score and source behind `?debug`.

The Inbox module page shows two titles ("Inbox", then the readme's h1, which wraps to 4 lines: layout.json `wraps` h1 lines 4 at 1200). Its `button primary` link also renders as a plain underlined link (shots/…Inbox/1200.png, band 2).
The count line wraps at 1200 and leaves "you" alone on line 2 (shots/…timeline/1200.png, band 2; widest_text sample).

`timeline/landings.jsonl` adds a 428 KB derived cache to git, under a parent task whose job is slimming the repo. The doc defends it (a static host needs it), but say in the parent's report that it costs 428 KB.
